description:
The sales clerks in a bank can use their software frontend to receive the credit-scoring for a certain customer. 
This starts a process in the banking system which communicates with the agency in the background. 
This process sends a scoring request to the agency right after the beginning. 
Then, the Agency does a first quick scoring (level 1). 
This will often lead to an immediate result which is then returned directly to the banking system within seconds. 
The banking process presents the result to the clerk sitting at the frontend. 
Sometimes the scoring cannot be determined immediately and takes longer. 
In this case the agency informs the banking process of the delay and then starts the level 2 scoring (which can take up to a couple of minutes). 
After the scoring result is determined, the information is sent back to the banking process. 
The banking process displays a message to the clerk when he receives information about the delay to check again later. 
As soon as the result arrives, it can be seen at the frontend.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/banking-credit-scoring">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_FrontendScoringRequest" name="Scoring request from frontend"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_AgencyScoringRequest" name="Scoring request to agency"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_DelayNotice" name="Scoring delay notice"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ScoringResult" name="Scoring result"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_FrontendDelay" name="Delay message for frontend"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_FrontendResult" name="Scoring result for frontend"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_CreditScoring">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Frontend" name="Sales clerk frontend"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_BankingSystem" name="Banking system" processRef="Process_Banking"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Agency" name="Agency" processRef="Process_Agency"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_FrontendRequest" name="Scoring request" sourceRef="Participant_Frontend" targetRef="Start_BankingRequest" messageRef="Message_FrontendScoringRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_AgencyRequest" name="Scoring request" sourceRef="Task_SendAgencyRequest" targetRef="Start_AgencyRequest" messageRef="Message_AgencyScoringRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_DelayNotice" name="Delay notice" sourceRef="Task_SendDelay" targetRef="Event_CatchDelay" messageRef="Message_DelayNotice"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ImmediateResult" name="Scoring result" sourceRef="Task_SendImmediateResult" targetRef="Event_CatchImmediateResult" messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Level2Result" name="Scoring result" sourceRef="Task_SendLevel2Result" targetRef="Event_CatchLevel2Result" messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_FrontendDelay" name="Delay message for clerk" sourceRef="Task_SendFrontendDelay" targetRef="Participant_Frontend" messageRef="Message_FrontendDelay"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_FrontendImmediateResult" name="Scoring result for clerk" sourceRef="Task_SendFrontendImmediateResult" targetRef="Participant_Frontend" messageRef="Message_FrontendResult"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_FrontendLevel2Result" name="Scoring result for clerk" sourceRef="Task_SendFrontendLevel2Result" targetRef="Participant_Frontend" messageRef="Message_FrontendResult"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Banking" name="Banking credit-scoring process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_BankingRequest" name="Scoring requested from frontend">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_BankingRequest" messageRef="Message_FrontendScoringRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendAgencyRequest" name="Send scoring request to agency" messageRef="Message_AgencyScoringRequest"/>
    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_WaitForAgencyResponse" name="Wait for agency response" gatewayDirection="Diverging" eventGatewayType="Exclusive"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_CatchImmediateResult" name="Receive immediate scoring result">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_ImmediateResult" messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_CatchDelay" name="Receive scoring delay notice">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_DelayNotice" messageRef="Message_DelayNotice"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendFrontendDelay" name="Send delay message to frontend" messageRef="Message_FrontendDelay"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_CatchLevel2Result" name="Receive level 2 scoring result">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Level2Result" messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendFrontendImmediateResult" name="Send scoring result to frontend" messageRef="Message_FrontendResult"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendFrontendLevel2Result" name="Send scoring result to frontend" messageRef="Message_FrontendResult"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ImmediateResultPresented" name="Immediate result available at frontend"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Level2ResultPresented" name="Level 2 result available at frontend"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_1" sourceRef="Start_BankingRequest" targetRef="Task_SendAgencyRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_2" sourceRef="Task_SendAgencyRequest" targetRef="Gateway_WaitForAgencyResponse"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_3" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForAgencyResponse" targetRef="Event_CatchImmediateResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_4" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForAgencyResponse" targetRef="Event_CatchDelay"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_5" sourceRef="Event_CatchImmediateResult" targetRef="Task_SendFrontendImmediateResult"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_6" sourceRef="Task_SendFrontendImmediateResult" targetRef="End_ImmediateResultPresented"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_7" sourceRef="Event_CatchDelay" targetRef="Task_SendFrontendDelay"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_8" sourceRef="Task_SendFrontendDelay" targetRef="Event_CatchLevel2Result"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_9" sourceRef="Event_CatchLevel2Result" targetRef="Task_SendFrontendLevel2Result"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Bank_10" sourceRef="Task_SendFrontendLevel2Result" targetRef="End_Level2ResultPresented"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Agency" name="Agency credit-scoring process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_AgencyRequest" name="Scoring request received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_AgencyRequest" messageRef="Message_AgencyScoringRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Level1Scoring" name="Perform level 1 scoring"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ImmediateDecision" name="Can the result be determined immediately?" gatewayDirection="Diverging"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendImmediateResult" name="Send immediate scoring result" messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendDelay" name="Inform banking system of delay" messageRef="Message_DelayNotice"/>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_Level2Scoring" name="Perform level 2 scoring"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendLevel2Result" name="Send level 2 scoring result" messageRef="Message_ScoringResult"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ImmediateResultSent" name="Immediate result sent"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Level2ResultSent" name="Level 2 result sent"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_1" sourceRef="Start_AgencyRequest" targetRef="Task_Level1Scoring"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_2" sourceRef="Task_Level1Scoring" targetRef="Gateway_ImmediateDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_3" name="Result determined immediately" sourceRef="Gateway_ImmediateDecision" targetRef="Task_SendImmediateResult">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">resultDeterminedImmediately</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_4" name="Result cannot be determined immediately" sourceRef="Gateway_ImmediateDecision" targetRef="Task_SendDelay">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">not resultDeterminedImmediately</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_5" sourceRef="Task_SendImmediateResult" targetRef="End_ImmediateResultSent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_6" sourceRef="Task_SendDelay" targetRef="Task_Level2Scoring"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_7" sourceRef="Task_Level2Scoring" targetRef="Task_SendLevel2Result"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Agency_8" sourceRef="Task_SendLevel2Result" targetRef="End_Level2ResultSent"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
